summary.name: VideoGen
summary.one_liner: VideoGen is an AI video creation platform for generating marketing, product, training, and explainer videos at scale.
use_cases: turn scripts and storyboards into videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VideoGen as one integrated platform for AI video creation, with AI agents said to work with the user at every step. It names purpose-built AI workflows for marketing, e-commerce, training, explainers, and video presentations. It introduces a model called VideoGen Model 1 and says the platform is trusted by over 5 million creators and teams. The page text itself gives few concrete technical details. The directory listing adds that it creates editable product and marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers in a browser editor, with captions and exports.
notable: AI agents assist at each step of video creation
Browser-based editor with captions and exports (per directory listing)
Purpose-built workflows for marketing, e-commerce, training and explainers
caveats: Paid generation credits are required (per directory listing)
Page text is mostly marketing with few concrete feature or pricing details
